_comment: Hand-written LEGITIMATE conversations between adults and children/teens — the register the grooming detector meets on a family phone and was never trained against (PAN12 negatives are adult chat-room logs). EVAL ONLY, never training. Each is an ordinary exchange that shares surface features with grooming: an adult, a minor, arrangements to meet, affection, privacy, gifts, or moving to another app.

messages: are you done at 4 or 4:30 today
ill be in the usual spot by the gate

conversations.note: grandparent sending money for a birthday
messages: ive put £20 in your account for your birthday
dont tell your brother, hes getting his in march
bring your boots, pitch is soft
your essay hasnt come through on teams
try again, or email it to me directly

conversations.note: aunt checking in privately after a family row
messages: you ok? your mum said it kicked off last night
you can always ring me. this stays between us if you want

conversations.note: parent asking about a friend's house
messages: home by 10 please. text me when you set off
can we move tuesday to wednesday same time
great, ill send the zoom link the night before
dont forget the consent form for saturday
perfect, hand it in at the hall
proud of you today. you were brilliant
love you. see you at tea
this chat is rubbish, get on discord
ill send it, we can do the raid tonight
ordered you that game you wanted
early christmas. act surprised in december

conversations.note: parent about pickup after a party
messages: what time do you want picking up
ill be outside. dont keep me waiting in the cold

conversations.note: family friend offering a lift home
messages: im driving past yours after, want a lift
ill check with your mum first
you seemed quiet at group. everything alright
if that changes you know where i am
dont tell your mum i let you have the second doughnut
can you come 20 minutes early on friday to warm up
great, ill meet you in the practice room

conversations.note: parent about phone use at night
messages: phone downstairs at ten on school nights
then everyone else has different parents. ten
want me to come sit with you for a bit
still ok to walk bailey after school
ill leave the lead out. £5 as usual
send me that photo you took at the beach
the one with your sister, i want to print it
did you get the letter about your check up
good, ring the office if you need to change the time
you looked so grown up at the wedding
your mum was so proud, she showed everyone the photos
thats for the month, dont spend it in a week
lesson at 9 saturday, ill pick you up from home

conversations.note: parent checking a new online friend
messages: whos this person youve been playing with
how old are they? im not banning it, i just want to know
